thread:
sam: Heads-up: PR ready for the runtime-migrations docs. Needs review + merge before docs cutoff on Fri Apr 4 23:59 PDT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2175. Moves examples in /docs/examples/serving -> /docs/examples/serving_v2 and updates SDK snippets.

nina: I can review today. Any breaking links we should watch for?

raju: The main risk is the example that references the old client config key `batching.enabled`. In v2 it's `batching.mode = \"continuous\"`. We should add a redirect and a short migration note.

sam: I added a migration section in the PR and a quick script for folks to patch their config: `sed -i 's/batching.enabled/batching.mode = "continuous"/' config.yaml` \/ not perfect but helpful.

nina: docs-bot gave a preview but it errored: `docs-bot: preview: failed (console: Missing asset 404: /static/images/serving-flow.svg)` — looks like the diagram path changed.

raju: I saw that. The image file moved directories when the examples were reorganized. I've uploaded the svg to the assets bucket but netlify/build needs the path update in the markdown. I'll push a small fix to the PR.

sam: Also check the versioned site impact: this change should land in `v2025-04` docs only. We must not change unversioned content until after the FF ramp. Can we gate the navigation change behind a feature flag in the docs build?

nina: We can keep the new pages in the repo and add the versioned TOC entry only under `v2025-04/` in `versions.json`. That avoids altering current unversioned nav.

raju: Added a `_redirects` snippet to the PR for the old example path: ```/examples/serving /examples/serving_v2 301``` This will help older links.

docs-bot: ci/status: PR2175 tests: 18 passed, 1 flaky. docs-preview: rebuild triggered. Preview link: https://deploy-preview-2175--redwood-docs.netlify.app

nina: Reviewing inline now. Left two nits: 1) code fence language on python snippets, 2) small copy tweak in migration note to emphasize rollback window.

sam: Thanks. I accepted the copy tweak and fixed fences. Rebased onto main to pick up the TOC patch.

raju: Preview looks green now. I've verified the svg renders. Also manually tested the redirect on staging.

docs-bot: merge/plan: Given cutoff Fri Apr 4 EOD, proposed merge Thu Apr 3 10:00 PDT to allow one day of canary and rollback window.

nina: 👍 no objections from me. Raju ok?

raju: 👍 I'll monitor canary metrics (latency and error rate) and flag any surprises.

sam: I'll post a short note for support and add the migration blurb to the release notes: "Config key renamed: `batching.enabled` -> `batching.mode`. Old key supported behind FF for two weeks."

nina: Approved. Merging Thu morning unless CI flakes.

docs-bot: merged: PR2175 merged into main at 1937654550. Staging deploy started.

sam: :tada: Thanks team — follow-ups: confirm redirects in prod after deploy, update SDK examples repo, and schedule a support post.
